claims.sentence: You must register on the Official Website as a Contest Participant
You must pass a specialized online test

A completed questionnaire on the Official Website containing your full name, date of birth, citizenship, city of residence, educational organization details, course of study, educational program, and details about the desired master's program (taught in Russian or English), plus other required data
A motivation letter in English explaining your reasons for seeking the Grant and studying at the University
A CV in English
A copy of your higher education diploma with appendices, or if you are a final-year bachelor's student, you may submit it after obtaining the diploma
If you are currently studying for a higher education degree during the first stage, a study certificate issued by your educational organization instead
An English language proficiency certificate if you have one
If you plan to study in an English-taught master's program, you must pass an online English language test
You may participate in the Contest no more than once during each contest period specified in clause 1.12 of the Regulation
You may send requests for clarifications regarding this Regulation to the Admissions and Recruitment Department of the University
You can contact them at the email address ayt!$510п$@1!ппоро!!5.ги or by phone at +7 (843) 203-92-53 (extension 183)
The evidence does not specify the exact dates or duration of the contest periods referenced in clause 1.12
The evidence does not define the content, format, or passing criteria of the specialized online test
The evidence does not clarify whether the English proficiency certificate is mandatory or strictly optional beyond the phrase "if available"
The evidence does not state deadlines for document submission or test completion
The evidence does not explain the procedure for final-year bachelor's students to submit their diploma after graduation
The evidence does not specify the consequences or procedure if you submit the contest more than once per period
The evidence does not detail the technical requirements or platform for the Official Website registration
The email address provided in the evidence contains OCR artifacts and may require verification
The evidence does not address how course pages or other university materials interact with this Regulation
